notes.title: Corruption Update!
notes.notes:
You speak, we listen. That's how this whole affair works. Viva la Indie Gaming!

We've addressed the game's starting difficulty when starting a new game from scratch with a couple of additions, as well as addressing a few other aspects of gameplay:

Given new players a slight stat and level increase over the original settings
Given new players a 'Home Gem' regardless of their plotline, allowing them to return to a point of safety when in trouble
All new players also start with a 'Grindhouse Gem' which allows them to train their party up, collect useful items and gear before continuing with the main story (this includes those transferring saves from Initiation, allowing you to retain access to the dungeon in Corruption)
Fixed an issue with voice files layering when the player skips dialogue
All teleport items now work without having to select a target

Hopefully, you find the new changes to your taste. As always, we're all ears to hear your thoughts and suggestions to make Corruption the most enjoyable experience possible!

-Ross
